sources.entry: Thor - Switch the right application ASAP.

summary.one_liner: Thor is a macOS app that opens or switches to a chosen application instantly via a keyboard shortcut.
summary.what_it_does: Thor is an OS X application that lets you open other applications immediately with a shortcut. The README says it is available on the Mac App Store. Its UI idea is credited to Pomodoro One, and it uses the MASShortcut library for shortcut handling. To build from source, you need Xcode 13.1 or later and CocoaPods, which installs the dependencies. A prebuilt release is available through a "download" link, which the README does not spell out further. The README is short and does not describe settings or detailed usage.
use_cases: switch to an app with a keyboard shortcut
launch frequently used Mac applications quickly
build a macOS app from source
replace clicking through the Dock or Spotlight to open apps
notable: Assigns a global keyboard shortcut to open or switch to a specific application
Available on the Mac App Store
UI idea borrowed from Pomodoro One
caveats: macOS only (described as an OS X application)
Building from source requires Xcode and CocoaPods
README gives little detail on features or configuration
